facts.value: For each passed exam, you will receive a digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), which is recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University. This will be issued bilingually (German and English). You can use this language certificate for your application abroad or later during your job search.

facts.value: Courses for all students: You can only find out your grades after you receive your certificate by email, approximately 4 to 5 weeks after the exam date. Elective module courses and Master's Course: You can view your grades password-protected in QIS.
